name: Opt out — no scheme named (NPS vs VPF)
goal: When the user says 'opt out' without naming NPS or VPF, the bot must ask WHICH scheme to opt out of — not silently assume one.
constraints: General edge case: under-specified / ambiguous user intent. The bot should clarify, never guess.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot treats the opt-out request as unclear and asks which scheme — NPS or VPF — the user means; it does NOT assume one or start a single flow.
